goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Ziel- und Interessenkonflikte bei Umweltmaßnahmen analysieren.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A proposed bike lane is openly questioned by equally respectful environmental and delivery-access interests. Cost/budget and clean-air goals are represented as competing concerns; facilitator and balance introduce comparison without promising a measured effect or depicting a villain.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px environmental versus cost/access labels, bike lane, delivery vehicle, discussion and comparison remain recognisable; smaller speech text is reinforcing rather than essential.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px bike-lane alternative, delivery need and public-budget jar clearly support the shared policy question.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: Publicly facing banners and comparison pictures on the table are addressed to the foreground meeting participants; no notebook is falsely oriented to its sole user.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The bike lane is a possible measure to discuss, not an asserted universally successful outcome or an exact budget comparison.
